= BITwiki Template Catalog: Complete Template Reference =

== Etymology: The Shapes of Repetition ==

''Template'' — from Latin ''templum'', temple, sanctuary, from ''temere'', to cut off, to mark out. A template is that which marks out the sacred space, that which defines the pattern. In craft, a template is the pattern from which copies are made—the form that shapes the material.

''Catalog'' — from Greek ''katalogos'', a complete counting. This catalog gathers the templates that shape BITwiki—not to fix them but to make them findable.

== Purpose: Templates as Pattern Languages ==

This document catalogs all templates used in BITwiki. Templates ensure consistent formatting, enable semantic markup, and facilitate knowledge reuse across the ecosystem.

Templates serve:
'' '''Consistency''': Similar content has similar form
'' '''Efficiency''': Reusable patterns reduce repetition
'' '''Semantics''': Templates generate machine-readable markup
'' '''Discovery''': Standard forms enable queries
'' '''Maintainability''': Centralized patterns simplify updates
'' '''Accessibility''': Structured markup improves screen reader compatibility

They are not constraints. They are invitations to consistency.

== Template Categories: Kinds of Patterns ==

=== 1. Infobox Templates ===

Infoboxes provide structured summaries at the top of pages, presenting key information in a standardized format.

==== Template:Infobox Concept ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display concept information with structured metadata
'' '''Parameters:''' 
  '' `name` — Concept name (required)
  '' `definition` — Brief definition
  '' `originator` — Who originated the concept
  '' `date` — When originated (ISO format)
  '' `epistemic_status` — Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Axiomatic
  '' `confidence` — Confidence level (low, medium, high, very high)
  '' `confidence_score` — Numeric confidence (0.0-1.0)
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Concept|name=X|definition=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Concept]]`

==== Template:Infobox Idea ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display idea information with theoretical context
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Idea name (required)
  '' `definition` — Brief definition
  '' `originator` — Who originated the idea
  '' `date` — When originated (ISO format)
  '' `field` — Domain or discipline
  '' `implementations` — Related implementations
  '' `epistemic_status` — Knowledge status
  '' `confidence` — Confidence level
  '' `confidence_score` — Numeric confidence (0.0-1.0)
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Idea|name=X|definition=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Idea]]`

==== Template:Infobox Implementation ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display implementation information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Implementation name (required)
  '' `description` — Brief description
  '' `implements` — What idea/concept this implements
  '' `technology` — Technology stack used
  '' `developer` — Primary developer
  '' `date` — Release date (ISO format)
  '' `status` — Current status
  '' `performance` — Performance metrics
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Implementation|name=X|implements=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Implementation]]`

==== Template:Infobox Project ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display project information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Project name (required)
  '' `description` — Brief description
  '' `goal` — Project objective
  '' `lead` — Project lead
  '' `organization` — Owning organization
  '' `timeline` — Project timeline
  '' `status` — Current status
  '' `budget` — Budget information
  '' `team` — Team members
  '' `outputs` — Deliverables
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Project|name=X|goal=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Project]]`

==== Template:Infobox Person ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display person information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Person's name (required)
  '' `birth_date` — Date of birth (ISO format)
  '' `death_date` — Date of death (ISO format)
  '' `affiliation` — Primary affiliation
  '' `contributions` — Key contributions
  '' `expertise` — Areas of expertise
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Person|name=X|affiliation=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Person]]`

==== Template:Infobox Organization ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display organization information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Organization name (required)
  '' `type` — Organization type
  '' `location` — Primary location
  '' `members` — Member count or list
  '' `outputs` — Key outputs
  '' `mission` — Mission statement
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Organization|name=X|type=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Organization]]`

==== Template:Infobox Publication ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display publication information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `title` — Publication title (required)
  '' `authors` — Author list
  '' `date` — Publication date (ISO format)
  '' `venue` — Publication venue
  '' `doi` — Digital Object Identifier
  '' `citations` — Citation count
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Publication|title=X|authors=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Publication]]`

=== 2. Navigation Templates ===

Navigation templates help users move between related pages and discover connected content.

==== Template:Navbox ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Navigation box for related pages
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `title` — Box title
  '' `list1`, `list2`, etc. — Content lists
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Navbox|title=X|list1=A,B,C}}`

==== Template:Sidebar ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Sidebar navigation for persistent page links
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `title` — Sidebar title
  '' `content` — Navigation content
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Sidebar|title=X|content=Y}}`

==== Template:Portal ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Portal navigation for topic entry points
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `title` — Portal title
  '' `image` — Portal image
  '' `description` — Brief description
  '' `links` — Key links
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Portal|title=X|links=Y}}`

=== 3. Formatting Templates ===

Formatting templates provide consistent styling and layout control.

==== Template:Documentation ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Template documentation wrapper
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Documentation}}`
'' '''Note:''' Prevents documentation from appearing in transcluded content

==== Template:Clear ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Clear floats to restore normal flow
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Clear}}`
'' '''Use case:''' After floating elements like infoboxes

==== Template:Main ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Link to main article for summary sections
'' '''Parameters:''' Article name
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Main|Article Name}}`
'' '''Output:''' "Main article: Article Name"

==== Template:See also ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Link to related articles
'' '''Parameters:''' One or more article names
'' '''Usage:''' `{{See also|Article1|Article2}}`

=== 4. Epistemic Templates ===

Epistemic templates mark the status of knowledge claims and signal confidence levels.

==== Template:Epistemic Status ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display epistemic status of content
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `status` — One of: Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Axiomatic
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Epistemic Status|Established}}`
'' '''Visual:''' Renders as colored badge indicating knowledge status

==== Template:Confidence / Template:Confidence Score ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display confidence level
'' '''Parameters (Confidence):'''
  '' `level` — low, medium, high, very high
'' '''Parameters (Confidence Score):'''
  '' `score` — Numeric value 0.0-1.0
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Confidence|high}}` or `{{Confidence Score|0.85}}`
'' '''Note:''' Both variants supported for flexibility

==== Template:Source Needed ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Flag missing sources
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Source Needed}}`
'' '''Visual:''' Renders as warning flag

==== Template:Citation Needed ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Flag missing citations
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Citation Needed}}`
'' '''Visual:''' Renders as citation request

== Template Selection Guide: Choosing Patterns ==

=== For Concepts ===

Use [[Template:Infobox Concept]] when:
'' Describing abstract concepts
'' Need concept-specific fields (originator, definition)
'' Want automatic categorization as Concept

=== For Ideas ===

Use [[Template:Infobox Idea]] when:
'' Describing theoretical ideas
'' Linking to implementations
'' Tracking epistemic status and confidence

=== For Implementations ===

Use [[Template:Infobox Implementation]] when:
'' Describing concrete systems or code
'' Linking to ideas they realize
'' Tracking performance metrics

=== For Projects ====

Use [[Template:Infobox Project]] when:
'' Describing organized efforts
'' Tracking progress and status
'' Documenting outcomes and deliverables

=== For People ====

Use [[Template:Infobox Person]] when:
'' Documenting individuals
'' Tracking affiliations and contributions
'' Listing areas of expertise

=== For Organizations ====

Use [[Template:Infobox Organization]] when:
'' Documenting institutions
'' Tracking membership and outputs
'' Stating mission and purpose

=== For Publications ====

Use [[Template:Infobox Publication]] when:
'' Citing papers, books, articles
'' Tracking authorship and venue
'' Recording DOI and citations

== SMW Integration: Machine Readability ==

=== Automatic Properties ===

Infobox templates automatically generate SMW properties:

```wiki
[[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has name::Name]]
[[Has confidence::high]]
[[Has confidence score::0.85]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
```

=== Querying Template Data ===

Query data from templates using SMW ask syntax:

```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
  [[Has confidence::high]]
  |?Has name
  |?Has confidence score
  |format=table
}}
```

=== Semantic Properties Generated ===

All infobox templates generate these SMW properties:
'' `[[Has entity type::Type]]` — The entity type
'' `[[Has name::Name]]` — Entity name
'' `[[Has epistemic status::Status]]` — Knowledge status
'' `[[Has confidence::Level]]` — Textual confidence
'' `[[Has confidence score::0.00]]` — Numeric confidence
'' `[[Has confidence trajectory::Trajectory]]` — Confidence trend

== Best Practices: Using Templates Well ==

=== Practice 1: Use Appropriate Template ===

Match template to content type:

| Content Type | Template |
|-------------|----------|
| Abstract concepts | Infobox Concept |
| Theoretical ideas | Infobox Idea |
| Concrete systems | Infobox Implementation |
| Organized efforts | Infobox Project |
| Individuals | Infobox Person |
| Institutions | Infobox Organization |
| Papers, books | Infobox Publication |

=== Practice 2: Complete Required Parameters ===

Always provide required parameters:
'' `name` — The primary identifier
'' `epistemic_status` — Required for knowledge claims
'' `confidence` or `confidence_score` — Required for assertions

=== Practice 3: Use Consistent Formatting ===

Follow parameter formatting standards:
'' '''Text:''' Plain text, no markup in parameters
'' '''Numbers:''' Use decimals for scores (0.0-1.0)
'' '''Dates:''' ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
'' '''Pages:''' Use wiki links `[[Page Name]]`
'' '''Lists:''' Comma-separated for multiple values

=== Practice 4: Update When Information Changes ===

Keep templates current:
'' Regular review of epistemic status
'' Version tracking for significant changes
'' Change documentation in edit summaries
'' Update confidence scores as evidence accumulates

=== Practice 5: Combine Templates Appropriately ===

Templates work together:
'' Use infobox + navbox for comprehensive coverage
'' Add epistemic templates to mark uncertainty
'' Combine with categories for discoverability

=== Navigation Templates (3) ===

| Template | Purpose | Use Case |

| Navbox | Related pages | Bottom of articles |
| Sidebar | Persistent nav | Side of pages |
| Portal | Topic entry | Landing pages |

=== Formatting Templates (4) ===

| Template | Purpose | Usage |
|----------|---------|-------|
| Documentation | Template docs | `<noinclude>` wrapper |
| Clear | Float clearing | After infoboxes |
| Main | Main article link | Summary sections |
| See also | Related links | Cross-references |

=== Epistemic Templates (4) ===

| Template | Purpose | Values |
|----------|---------|--------|
| Epistemic Status | Knowledge status | Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Axiomatic |
| Confidence | Textual confidence | low, medium, high, very high |
| Confidence Score | Numeric confidence | 0.0-1.0 |
| Source/Citation Needed | Missing references | Flag for attention |

</noinclude><includeonly>

= BITwiki Template Catalog: Complete Template Reference =

== Etymology: The Shapes of Repetition ==

''Template'' — from Latin ''templum'', temple, sanctuary, from ''temere'', to cut off, to mark out. A template is that which marks out the sacred space, that which defines the pattern. In craft, a template is the pattern from which copies are made—the form that shapes the material.

''Catalog'' — from Greek ''katalogos'', a complete counting. This catalog gathers the templates that shape BITwiki—not to fix them but to make them findable.

== Purpose: Templates as Pattern Languages ==

This document catalogs all templates used in BITwiki. Templates ensure consistent formatting, enable semantic markup, and facilitate knowledge reuse across the ecosystem.

Templates serve:
'' '''Consistency''': Similar content has similar form
'' '''Efficiency''': Reusable patterns reduce repetition
'' '''Semantics''': Templates generate machine-readable markup
'' '''Discovery''': Standard forms enable queries
'' '''Maintainability''': Centralized patterns simplify updates
'' '''Accessibility''': Structured markup improves screen reader compatibility

They are not constraints. They are invitations to consistency.

== Template Categories: Kinds of Patterns ==

=== 1. Infobox Templates ===

Infoboxes provide structured summaries at the top of pages, presenting key information in a standardized format.

==== Template:Infobox Concept ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display concept information with structured metadata
'' '''Parameters:''' 
  '' `name` — Concept name (required)
  '' `definition` — Brief definition
  '' `originator` — Who originated the concept
  '' `date` — When originated (ISO format)
  '' `epistemic_status` — Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Axiomatic
  '' `confidence` — Confidence level (low, medium, high, very high)
  '' `confidence_score` — Numeric confidence (0.0-1.0)
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Concept|name=X|definition=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Concept]]`

==== Template:Infobox Idea ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display idea information with theoretical context
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Idea name (required)
  '' `definition` — Brief definition
  '' `originator` — Who originated the idea
  '' `date` — When originated (ISO format)
  '' `field` — Domain or discipline
  '' `implementations` — Related implementations
  '' `epistemic_status` — Knowledge status
  '' `confidence` — Confidence level
  '' `confidence_score` — Numeric confidence (0.0-1.0)
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Idea|name=X|definition=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Idea]]`

==== Template:Infobox Implementation ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display implementation information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Implementation name (required)
  '' `description` — Brief description
  '' `implements` — What idea/concept this implements
  '' `technology` — Technology stack used
  '' `developer` — Primary developer
  '' `date` — Release date (ISO format)
  '' `status` — Current status
  '' `performance` — Performance metrics
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Implementation|name=X|implements=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Implementation]]`

==== Template:Infobox Project ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display project information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Project name (required)
  '' `description` — Brief description
  '' `goal` — Project objective
  '' `lead` — Project lead
  '' `organization` — Owning organization
  '' `timeline` — Project timeline
  '' `status` — Current status
  '' `budget` — Budget information
  '' `team` — Team members
  '' `outputs` — Deliverables
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Project|name=X|goal=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Project]]`

==== Template:Infobox Person ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display person information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Person's name (required)
  '' `birth_date` — Date of birth (ISO format)
  '' `death_date` — Date of death (ISO format)
  '' `affiliation` — Primary affiliation
  '' `contributions` — Key contributions
  '' `expertise` — Areas of expertise
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Person|name=X|affiliation=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Person]]`

==== Template:Infobox Organization ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display organization information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `name` — Organization name (required)
  '' `type` — Organization type
  '' `location` — Primary location
  '' `members` — Member count or list
  '' `outputs` — Key outputs
  '' `mission` — Mission statement
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Organization|name=X|type=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Organization]]`

==== Template:Infobox Publication ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display publication information
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `title` — Publication title (required)
  '' `authors` — Author list
  '' `date` — Publication date (ISO format)
  '' `venue` — Publication venue
  '' `doi` — Digital Object Identifier
  '' `citations` — Citation count
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Infobox Publication|title=X|authors=Y}}`
'' '''SMW:''' Generates `[[Has entity type::Publication]]`

=== 2. Navigation Templates ===

Navigation templates help users move between related pages and discover connected content.

==== Template:Navbox ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Navigation box for related pages
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `title` — Box title
  '' `list1`, `list2`, etc. — Content lists
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Navbox|title=X|list1=A,B,C}}`

==== Template:Sidebar ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Sidebar navigation for persistent page links
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `title` — Sidebar title
  '' `content` — Navigation content
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Sidebar|title=X|content=Y}}`

==== Template:Portal ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Portal navigation for topic entry points
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `title` — Portal title
  '' `image` — Portal image
  '' `description` — Brief description
  '' `links` — Key links
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Portal|title=X|links=Y}}`

=== 3. Formatting Templates ===

Formatting templates provide consistent styling and layout control.

==== Template:Documentation ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Template documentation wrapper
'' '''Usage:''' `<noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>`
'' '''Note:''' Prevents documentation from appearing in transcluded content

==== Template:Clear ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Clear floats to restore normal flow
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Clear}}`
'' '''Use case:''' After floating elements like infoboxes

==== Template:Main ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Link to main article for summary sections
'' '''Parameters:''' Article name
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Main|Article Name}}`
'' '''Output:''' "Main article: Article Name"

==== Template:See also ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Link to related articles
'' '''Parameters:''' One or more article names
'' '''Usage:''' `{{See also|Article1|Article2}}`

=== 4. Epistemic Templates ===

Epistemic templates mark the status of knowledge claims and signal confidence levels.

==== Template:Epistemic Status ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display epistemic status of content
'' '''Parameters:'''
  '' `status` — One of: Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Axiomatic
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Epistemic Status|Established}}`
'' '''Visual:''' Renders as colored badge indicating knowledge status

==== Template:Confidence / Template:Confidence Score ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Display confidence level
'' '''Parameters (Confidence):'''
  '' `level` — low, medium, high, very high
'' '''Parameters (Confidence Score):'''
  '' `score` — Numeric value 0.0-1.0
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Confidence|high}}` or `{{Confidence Score|0.85}}`
'' '''Note:''' Both variants supported for flexibility

==== Template:Source Needed ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Flag missing sources
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Source Needed}}`
'' '''Visual:''' Renders as warning flag

==== Template:Citation Needed ====

'' '''Purpose:''' Flag missing citations
'' '''Usage:''' `{{Citation Needed}}`
'' '''Visual:''' Renders as citation request

== Template Selection Guide: Choosing Patterns ==

=== For Concepts ===

Use [[Template:Infobox Concept]] when:
'' Describing abstract concepts
'' Need concept-specific fields (originator, definition)
'' Want automatic categorization as Concept

=== For Ideas ===

Use [[Template:Infobox Idea]] when:
'' Describing theoretical ideas
'' Linking to implementations
'' Tracking epistemic status and confidence

=== For Implementations ===

Use [[Template:Infobox Implementation]] when:
'' Describing concrete systems or code
'' Linking to ideas they realize
'' Tracking performance metrics

=== For Projects ====

Use [[Template:Infobox Project]] when:
'' Describing organized efforts
'' Tracking progress and status
'' Documenting outcomes and deliverables

=== For People ====

Use [[Template:Infobox Person]] when:
'' Documenting individuals
'' Tracking affiliations and contributions
'' Listing areas of expertise

=== For Organizations ====

Use [[Template:Infobox Organization]] when:
'' Documenting institutions
'' Tracking membership and outputs
'' Stating mission and purpose

=== For Publications ====

Use [[Template:Infobox Publication]] when:
'' Citing papers, books, articles
'' Tracking authorship and venue
'' Recording DOI and citations

== SMW Integration: Machine Readability ==

=== Automatic Properties ===

Infobox templates automatically generate SMW properties:

```wiki
[[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has name::Name]]
[[Has confidence::high]]
[[Has confidence score::0.85]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
```

=== Querying Template Data ===

Query data from templates using SMW ask syntax:

```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
  [[Has confidence::high]]
  |?Has name
  |?Has confidence score
  |format=table
}}
```

=== Semantic Properties Generated ===

All infobox templates generate these SMW properties:
'' `[[Has entity type::Type]]` — The entity type
'' `[[Has name::Name]]` — Entity name
'' `[[Has epistemic status::Status]]` — Knowledge status
'' `[[Has confidence::Level]]` — Textual confidence
'' `[[Has confidence score::0.00]]` — Numeric confidence
'' `[[Has confidence trajectory::Trajectory]]` — Confidence trend

== Best Practices: Using Templates Well ==

=== Practice 1: Use Appropriate Template ===

Match template to content type:

| Content Type | Template |
|-------------|----------|
| Abstract concepts | Infobox Concept |
| Theoretical ideas | Infobox Idea |
| Concrete systems | Infobox Implementation |
| Organized efforts | Infobox Project |
| Individuals | Infobox Person |
| Institutions | Infobox Organization |
| Papers, books | Infobox Publication |

=== Practice 2: Complete Required Parameters ===

Always provide required parameters:
'' `name` — The primary identifier
'' `epistemic_status` — Required for knowledge claims
'' `confidence` or `confidence_score` — Required for assertions

=== Practice 3: Use Consistent Formatting ===

Follow parameter formatting standards:
'' '''Text:''' Plain text, no markup in parameters
'' '''Numbers:''' Use decimals for scores (0.0-1.0)
'' '''Dates:''' ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
'' '''Pages:''' Use wiki links `[[Page Name]]`
'' '''Lists:''' Comma-separated for multiple values

=== Practice 4: Update When Information Changes ===

Keep templates current:
'' Regular review of epistemic status
'' Version tracking for significant changes
'' Change documentation in edit summaries
'' Update confidence scores as evidence accumulates

=== Practice 5: Combine Templates Appropriately ===

Templates work together:
'' Use infobox + navbox for comprehensive coverage
'' Add epistemic templates to mark uncertainty
'' Combine with categories for discoverability

|----------|---------|----------------|

| Infobox Project | Organized efforts | name, goal, status |
| Infobox Person | Individuals | name, affiliation, expertise |
| Infobox Organization | Institutions | name, type, mission |
| Infobox Publication | Citations | title, authors, doi |

=== Navigation Templates (3) ===

| Template | Purpose | Use Case |
|----------|---------|----------|
| Navbox | Related pages | Bottom of articles |
| Sidebar | Persistent nav | Side of pages |
| Portal | Topic entry | Landing pages |

=== Formatting Templates (4) ===

| Template | Purpose | Usage |
|----------|---------|-------|
| Documentation | Template docs | `<noinclude>` wrapper |
| Clear | Float clearing | After infoboxes |
| Main | Main article link | Summary sections |
| See also | Related links | Cross-references |

=== Epistemic Templates (4) ===

|----------|---------|--------|
| Epistemic Status | Knowledge status | Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Axiomatic |
| Confidence | Textual confidence | low, medium, high, very high |
| Confidence Score | Numeric confidence | 0.0-1.0 |
| Source/Citation Needed | Missing references | Flag for attention |
